sections.name: notes_owed
value: C32(1): generated nonquiet notice uses asserted actor as sender; use daemon sender with explicit asserted-actor provenance.
C32(3): different retry actor controls sender/notice effect without fresh atomic assertion audit; replay immutable audited intent or audit the new assertion.

sections.value:
Security verdict: BLOCK

PR: #149
Head: e0004f856f665cdeec03a62b0f48e769f342bea2
Scope: 697b6aa..e0004f8, combined with retained fb87062..697b6aa review. Graded against clarified C32.

| # | Severity | File | Lines | Vulnerability | Confidence |
|---|----------|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| 1 | 🟡 MEDIUM | crates/daemon/src/http/requests.rs | 477-492 | Asserted holder can send a close FYI as another seat | 9/10 |

S003 remains OPEN under C32(1), not because stronger cryptographic caller authentication is required.

An actual caller A asserts stored holder B and performs a nonquiet close of requester C's request. tell_requester assigns Msg.from=B, delivery preserves HeldFyi.sender, and core/fyi.rs:174-186 visibly renders "[from B, ...]" rather than a daemon sender or asserted-actor attribution. The notice has a structured prefix but contains caller-controlled --why text. C32's explicit no-send-as exclusion has no structured-notice exception.

New requester/self closes skip notification; they do not protect this holder-to-different-requester path.

Owed retry also fails the clarified C32(3) assertion boundary. requests.rs:331-347 freshly authorizes its retry actor, passes that actor to notify_owned, and does not call close_audited. If original closer D left an owed notice, a later asserted-holder B retry sends as B, preserves D's stored body/reason, and marks the notice told without atomically auditing B's fresh assertion. The original D audit does not cover a different assertion affecting sender identity. Retry --why is ignored; the initial stored reason remains.

Required repair: use a daemon sender with explicit asserted-actor attribution and preserve original closer provenance. Either replay immutable audited daemon intent without fresh identity-dependent effects, or atomically audit the fresh retry assertion/effect. Then update the Known limit to the exact residual.

Closed/preserved boundaries:
- C32(2)'s narrow restrictions hold: contradictory pane/asserted IDs refuse; asserted-only authority is requester/holder, not PA/prime.
- Initial close/withdraw atomicity is repaired: role_requests.rs:952-987 writes request.closed_by_actor in the same owned transaction before commit. Append failure rolls back; non-moves/replays add no duplicate. Later broadcast failure is not missing durable audit.
- S004 remains CLOSED: scoped projects.prime_id, no self-role/current-designation fallback.
- S005 is CLOSED, including the new hostile-holder generated-notice test at directory_http.rs:4611-4646. Both state/release commands specify /bin/sh exact-word/no-file checks. The fixture seeds registry data and lacks an unescaped positive control; no test was executed here.
- Original S001/S002, project routing, role gates, owned drain, notification failure surfacing and request-body omission remain preserved. Prior tmux proof limits remain.

Evidence: exact-head CI42384775056 and Delivers42384775073 independently verified SUCCESS; remote and PR heads agree, CLEAN. Green cases do not establish these notice sender/retry audit boundaries.
https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42384775056

No local builds/tests, close calls, fault injection, role assertions, credential reads or product edits. F103 remains its separate recorded handoff.
